The diff also changes non-dry-run behavior to `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)`, which performs a live `open(url).read` network fetch per thread (app/models/topic_embed.rb), making imports dependent on network availability compared to the prior behavior that created a post from metadata only.
